title: Lifecycle Source Laboratory
objective: Provide a product-neutral proving ground where one schema-valid Plan machine source crosses deterministic semantic validation, two real WPRA no-effect runs, and generated human-view rendering before any execution authority can exist.
out_of_scope: publication, deployment, network, or external effects
success_criteria: one machine source is the only authored Plan input
invalid source or downstream consumer failure publishes no plan projection
two real WPRA runs pass with one equal non-null projection digest
human work-pack view is derived from validated machine bytes
negative cases prove route, authority, write, budget, phase, receipt, and continuity drift block

identity_denominator.rationale: The laboratory defines no canonical external ID-to-label denominator.
